text:
Lina - Partnerships: quick heads-up, ACME HW asked for our SOC2 and pen artifacts to finish their marketplace listing. who can own?
Eric - Security: do we plan to hand over the full pen report or a redacted package + attestation? raw PoCs usually a no-go.
Marta - Legal: redact PoCs and internal network diagrams. include CVE IDs, mitigation summaries, and an attestation letter. we should avoid raw exploit code or internal IP.
Jonas - Solutions: propose a standardized bundle layout so partners know what to expect:
- compliance/{partner}/SOC2_YYYYMM.pdf
- compliance/{partner}/pen-redacted.zip
- compliance/{partner}/attestation.txt
- compliance/{partner}/manifest.json
Priya - SI Eng: i can handle packaging and presign links. need redaction checklist + who signs the attestation. also need ACME contact and desired S3 path.
Lina - Partnerships: ACME contact rachel@acme-hw.com. they want artifacts by EOD next wednesday for their marketplace window. can we meet that? :hourglass:
Eric - Security: pen team can prioritize. estimate redacted bundle ready by Tuesday EOD. SOC2 PDF is available (2024-09-15).
Marta - Legal: i'll draft a one-paragraph attestation template today. sign flow: Security -> Legal -> Partnerships.
Jonas - Solutions: presign TTL recommendation: 7 days (168h). one-time upload token + presigned PUT for partner ingestion. infra-bot, please create upload path and presign policy.
infra-bot: presign request acknowledged. created upload prefix: s3://redwood-compliance-staging/acme-hw/1831112222-upload/ and presign TTL=168h. temporary creds created for one-time PUT.
Priya - SI Eng: thanks. i'll add an upload README and an md5 verification step. sample command to upload:
```
curl -X PUT "{PRESIGN_URL}" --upload-file pen-redacted.zip -H "Content-Type: application/zip"
```
after upload run:
```
openssl dgst -sha256 pen-redacted.zip
```
Jonas - Solutions: i'll drop a tiny validation script to check the manifest, SOC2 filename, and presence of attestation before we hand off the final presign. will push to repo and link here.
Marta - Legal: require S3 access logging enabled for that prefix and retention set to 90 days for audit. also note: attestation must reference the redaction level.
Eric - Security: reminder: scrub any partner-specific keys, API tokens, or screenshots that may reveal internal hostnames. redact PoC steps. we can include sanitized repro steps if needed.
Lina - Partnerships: i'll confirm with ACME that redacted artifacts + attestation are acceptable and that they don't need PoCs. will copy rachel into the next message.
Priya - SI Eng: assigning myself owner for packaging and upload orchestration. i'll post progress updates by EOD tomorrow.
Lina - Partnerships: great, thanks everyone :rocket:
